name: gas-template
description: Preact + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 + TypeScript Google Apps Script template

scripts.copy:manifest: bun -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('appsscript.json', 'dist/appsscript.json');"
scripts.build: bun run copy:manifest && vite build --config vite.config.script.ts && vite build --config vite.config.ui.ts
scripts.deploy: bun run build && clasp push && clasp deploy
